audit.why: Lane difficulty framing (even lane, safe farm early, Malzahar takes over at 6 and out-scales via suppression on a swing-reliant enemy) matches both kits and the 53.39% WR over 2019 games.
Spikes (Lost Chapter shove engine, level 6 Nether Grasp, Liandry's) are accurate; spikes[] has all 4 entries and matches the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers; full-layer level chart rows 0 and 1 are swapped versus packet, content win[], and the whys; dos/donts bodies are pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; Akshan W camouflage (missing interaction) unmentioned.
audit.why: Akshan E Heroic Swing is 18s rank 1 / 12s max — the exact window the whole gameplan keys on. His R Comeuppance is 100/85/70. Malzahar R is 140/110/80. Nether Grasp is point-and-click and stops the swing; Akshan's Q/E/R are all projectiles but Malzahar has no projectile-blocker, so that is not written. Going Rogue camouflage needs Control Ward/sweeper.
audit.corrected: See edits: real cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns, chart rows fixed, dos/donts bodies rewritten to match their titles, camouflage warning added.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: E a caster minion and let the visions farm — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from wave one.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: His Avengerang poke out-ranges you at 2 — hold your Q silence for Heroic Swing, not poke he sidesteps.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Akshan wins by shredding your passive with Avengerang, swinging in before your 6, and turning kills into Going Rogue revives.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1, 12s maxed — his only engage and escape; fight only while it is down. - His Comeuppance is a 100s cooldown early: once fired, no execute for a minute-plus. - Your Nether Grasp is 140/110/80s — hold it for names, not waves.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Heroic Swing runs an 18-second cooldown at rank 1 — your Q silence mid-approach knocks him out of the pattern, so save it for the swing, never the boomerang.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: With your passive broken and Nether Grasp on its 140-second cooldown, plates are not worth it — Going Rogue camouflage lets him collapse on you unseen.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crash into cross-map pressure. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: - Malzahar vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing. - Guard the spell shield — trade only when it is intact. - Heroic Swing down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Malzahar vs Akshan - Track: Akshan Heroic Swing — 18s early. - Trade only with your spell shield intact. - Control Ward for Going Rogue camouflage. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
